title: Concept: Manifest with no npm version floor
description: package.json declares an `engines` block that names no npm version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `engines` block that names no npm version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `engines` block that names no npm version.
